# Fabian Bammes

> Experimental physicist specialising in electron optics: controlling free electrons with chip-based electrode structures. Master's student in physics at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg (graduating end of 2026), working at the Chair of Laser Physics (Prof. Peter Hommelhoff). Looking for a PhD position in semiconductor and quantum devices.

This is Fabian Bammes' personal website. The CV page is the authoritative source for his professional background; the rest of the site (plants, bees, dice games) is a private hobby project. Every page exists in German and English.

## Profile

- [CV (English)](https://fabibause12.github.io/werdegang-en.html): education, master's thesis, research positions, publications, skills
- [CV (German)](https://fabibause12.github.io/werdegang.html): same content in German
- [Home page (English)](https://fabibause12.github.io/index-en.html): short introduction and contact

- [FAU staff page](https://www.laserphysics.nat.fau.eu/person/fabian-bammes/): official page at the Chair of Laser Physics

## Key facts

- Research: guiding and manipulating free electron beams on chips with planar electrode structures (auto-ponderomotive potentials); building blocks for a quantum electron microscope
- Master's thesis (2025–2026, Chair of Laser Physics, FAU): beam switch and ring resonator for multi-pass measurements, FEM simulation of electrode geometries, fabrication, measurement of a newly identified guiding regime
- Student research assistant (2023–2025, Chair of Laser Physics, FAU): scanning electron microscope, ultra-high vacuum, field emission tips
- Bachelor's in Physics (2019–2024, FAU); bachelor's thesis on an auto-ponderomotive S-curve
- Skills: COMSOL Multiphysics, Python, MATLAB, C, KiCad, chip and PCB design, wire bonding, MSLA 3D printing
- Languages: German (native), English (fluent)

## Publications

- F. Schmidt-Kaler, M. Seidling, R. Zimmermann, N. Bode, F. Bammes, L. Radtke, P. Hommelhoff: "Planar On-Chip Auto-Ponderomotive Devices for Electron Beam Control", 37th International Vacuum Nanoelectronics Conference (IVNC), 2024. https://doi.org/10.1109/IVNC63480.2024.10652402
- Manuscript as co-author, Physical Review Letters – resubmitted after peer review
- Patent application on guiding electrons with three-dimensional structures
